title: Starbloom Planter
summary: Legendary planter. Place anywhere: grows Starbloom every 5 min, whatever the light or weather. Right-click or hit it when ripe. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up.

lines.x: Place anywhere: grows Starbloom every 5 min, whatever the light or weather. Right-click or hit it when ripe. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up.
